source.snippet: I need some character voice acting for an animation I'm making. The response from people when I used Elevenlabs was that it felt flat and characters were inconsistent. I was previously using the voice reference on seedance 2.0, but obviously that's limited to 15 seconds, and I have 40 lines I have to go through. Finally I just spent $75 on a human voice actor for subpar work that I can't use. Anyways, is there anything better than elevenlabs right now to carry emotional tone or carry a consistent voice character across many lines?

problem_statement: Independent animators and video creators need consistent, emotionally expressive AI character voices across many lines of dialogue, but current tools (ElevenLabs etc.) produce flat, inconsistent results, forcing them to pay human voice actors who also underdeliver.
target_segment: Independent animators, short film creators, and solo video producers who need multi-line character voice acting for productions
notes: Buyer paid $75 on a human voice actor (wasted spend) and separately paid for ElevenLabs subscription. Explicit willingness to pay for a better solution. Pain is multi-dimensional: consistency across takes AND emotional range. Volume constraint (40 lines) rules out video-synced tools limited to 15s clips. Opportunity: a workflow tool or managed service that combines best-in-class TTS models with character-profile locking and batch processing for animation pipelines. Competing products named: ElevenLabs, Seedance 2.0.
